rootCause: WorkerSession.open's tool observer passed the exact SDK web_search tool through generic authorizeTool, producing {type:'tool',toolName:'web_search'}. Host worker-operation-authorizer only admits listed native tools or exact toolRequests entries, so it denied before NativeWebSearch's own guarded transport could request {type:'web-search'}.
fix: In the tool observer, after the existing profile allowedTools check, exact event.toolName === 'web_search' calls authorize({type:'web-search'}); all other tools continue through authorizeTool. No Host authorizer broadening or bypass was added.
